watchOuts.text: In the week of {week.1.start} your load rose to {week.1.load}, an ACWR of {week.1.acwrAtEnd} in the {week.1.acwrBand} band, above your recent norm.

suggestion.text: Keep easy days easy and raise weekly load gradually, so that it stays close to your recent norm.

dataNotes.text: The low ratio in the week of {week.4.start} was the lighter week before your {race.1.category}: a taper, not a dip.
